data: At what number of sort iterations does the red line reach a local peak?

The red line in the graph represents the perplexity scores for different numbers of sort iterations. The x-axis shows the number of sort iterations, ranging from 0 to 30. The y-axis shows the perplexity scores, ranging from approximately 42 to 52. The red line starts at a high value and decreases rapidly, reaching a local peak around 2 iterations. After this point, the line continues to decrease slightly but remains relatively flat. Therefore, the red line reaches a local peak at approximately 2 sort iterations.
